comments.P: Commit strip + mono passage tape with inbound/outbound two-state lock is a true harbour desk: density-8, motion-1, imageless, amber fault-only, Ctrl+Enter, all four states, six tokens — would build first.
comments.Q: Product Demo + Features / Swiss Minimalism with Rubik/Nunito and blue/orange system accents is marketing-template grammar for a desktop ops console; states, Ctrl+Enter, and density-8 instrument discipline are under-specified.
comments.R: Correct full-width real-interface mode and keyboard-first intent, but type/signature stay abstract (“UI sans pair”, “work-canvas”), unknowns undeclared, and field/state layout lacks the strip/tape precision of stronger packs.
comments.S: Movements chalkboard with permanent chalk-entry head strip and Ctrl+Enter stamp is the most memorable harbour metaphor while still locking density-8, amber-only faults, and imageless ops — strongest direction, type slightly less tokenized than P.
comments.T: Form-left/log-right cockpit is a clean density-8 desk with mono times and amber-rationed status strip; fully anti-fintech and shippable, signature less singular than direction-lock or chalk-entry strip.
